claim: This round's VRC4T-01 fix makes §8.8 (l. 14380–14383) apply a device-pixel-ratio change 'while the view is settled — at once when no gesture runs, at the gesture's settle otherwise — and at most once in 10 s, counted with the loop's changes, so one coming within 10 s of the last change applies when those 10 s end'. That is R4-10's one phrase 'wherever Auto's or a device-pixel-ratio change's timing is stated', and T-ER-26 now runs the case. V09 still states that timing without the clause. §4.21.11 (2) (l. 3595–3597) reads 'A change takes effect while the view is settled — at once when no gesture runs, at the gesture's settle otherwise — never during a pan, zoom or drag (§8.8)'. T-V9-84 (l. 4435), the test that takes T121-7, reads 'a device-pixel-ratio change re-evaluates within one frame and the level changes while the view is settled — at once when no gesture runs, at the gesture's settle otherwise (§8.8; T121-7)'. For a monitor change with the view idle within 10 s of a loop step-down, §8.8 and T-ER-26 apply it when the 10 s end, while V09's text and bar apply it at once. This is two units stating two outcomes for one case (R5-01's grading), and R5-01 (2) (b) puts V09's restatements in the sweep. R4-10's END texts for these two sites were written before §8.8 stated the within-10-s outcome.
required_change: V09 §4.21.11 (2): '… at the gesture's settle otherwise — never during a pan, zoom or drag (§8.8)' → '… at the gesture's settle otherwise — never during a pan, zoom or drag, and a change Auto's loop decides or a device-pixel-ratio change brings at most once in 10 s, counted together, so one coming within 10 s of the last applies when those 10 s end (§8.8)'.
